description: Two young people sandboarding down a huge orange sand dune under a clear blue sky. A young woman in a yellow top and black shorts crouches low on her board and speeds down in front, her braids flying and sand spraying up behind her, and she laughs. Further up the slope a young man in a white open shirt and navy shorts rides his board more slowly behind her, his arms spread out for balance. A four-wheel-drive car and a lone tree stand far below at the foot of the dune.
